farm_pond.note: 21 new farm ponds in Ballia tehsil show no average change in cropping intensity around them that can be told apart from zero: +6.6 points (95% range −2.5 to +15.4). 5 show a likely gain or an early sign of one and 3 a loss, against about 2 each expected by chance.
